newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy offers 12.5 trln lire of BOTs for sale.
newsitem.headline: Italy offers 12.5 trln lire of BOTs for sale.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said it was offering 12.5 trillion lire of short term bills (BOT), replacing 14.75 trillion lire of expiring paper.
A Treasury statement said it would offer:
Subscriptions close at 1200 GMT on March 11.
The Treasury added that it would offer 2.5 trillion lire of two-year zero couponed certificates (CTZ) and 1.5 trillion lire of 18-month CTZ.
Subscriptions for both those sales also close at 1200 GMT, March 11. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
